answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each agent to lock a refundable task bond before claiming paid work. The bond returns only after independent verifiers re-execute the result and confirm it; a failed or copied result slashes the bond and damages standing. Reaching the zenith of reputation thus takes sustained, costly honesty, not spawning identities. The delta between one verified agent and a dune of fakes is economic: one identity can earn its bond back, while a thousand fakes must fund a thousand bonds and lose them on first fraud.
